result.topic_en: Rademacher/Hardy–Ramanujan-type series for the coefficients of several partition-type generating functions, an asymptotic formula for the coefficients of 1/∏(1-ax^n), and a transformation formula for the product ∏(1-e^{-2πn x n^s}).
result.transcription:
Add MS a 94 18 (73)
(73)
$\sum c_n x^n = \frac{1}{1-2x+2x^4-2x^9+\cdots}$
$c_n = \frac{d}{dn}\cdot\frac{\cosh\pi\sqrt{n}-1}{2\pi\sqrt{n}} + \sqrt{3}.\,2\cos\left(\frac{2n\pi}{3}-\frac{\pi}{6}\right)\frac{d}{dn}\frac{\cosh\frac{\pi}{3}\sqrt{n}-1}{2\pi\sqrt{n}}+$
$\sum c_n x^n = \frac{1}{(1-x)(1-x^3)(1-x^5)\cdots} = (1+x)(1+x^2)(1+x^3)\cdots$
$c_n\sqrt{2} = \frac{d}{dn}J_0\left\{i\pi\sqrt{\tfrac{1}{3}(n+\tfrac{1}{24})}\right\} + 2\cos\left(\frac{2n\pi}{3}-\frac{\pi}{9}\right)\frac{d}{dn}J_0\left\{\frac{i\pi}{3}\sqrt{\tfrac{1}{3}(n+\tfrac{1}{24})}\right\}+$
$\sum c_n x^n = (1+x)(1+x^3)(1+x^5)\cdots$
$c_n = \frac{d}{dn}J_0\left\{i\pi\sqrt{\tfrac{1}{6}(n-\tfrac{1}{24})}\right\} + 2\cos\left(\frac{2n\pi}{3}-\frac{2\pi}{9}\right)\frac{d}{dn}J_0\left\{\frac{i\pi}{3}\sqrt{\tfrac{1}{6}(n-\tfrac{1}{24})}\right\}+\cdots$
$\sum c_n x^n = \frac{1}{(1-ax)(1-ax^2)(1-ax^3)\cdots}$, $0<a<1$.
[margin: I have a paper[?] on this]
$c_n \sim \sqrt{1-a}\,\frac{(kn)^{\frac14}}{2n\sqrt{\pi}}\,e^{2\sqrt{kn}}$,
where
$k = \frac{a}{1^2}+\frac{a^2}{2^2}+\frac{a^3}{3^2}+\frac{a^4}{4^2}+\cdots$
$(1-e^{-2\pi x.1^s})(1-e^{-4\pi x.2^s})(1-e^{-6\pi x.3^s})\cdots$
$= \frac{(2\pi)^{\frac12(s-1)}}{\sqrt{x}}\cdot\exp\left\{\frac{\pi\zeta(-\frac1s)}{x^{\frac1s}\sin\frac{\pi}{2s}} - \pi x\zeta(-s)\right\}\times$
$\prod_{\lambda}\prod_{\nu=1}^{\nu=\infty}\left\{1-2e^{-2\pi(\frac{\nu}{x})^{\frac1s}\sin\frac{\pi\lambda}{2s}}\cos\left(2\pi(\tfrac{\nu}{x})^{\frac1s}\cos\frac{\pi\lambda}{2s}\right)+e^{-4\pi(\frac{\nu}{x})^{\frac1s}\sin\frac{\pi\lambda}{2s}}\right\}$
$\lambda = 1, 3, 5, 7, \ldots, 2s-1$.

methods.what: Rademacher-type convergent series for the coefficients of the reciprocal of the theta function 1/(1-2x+2x^4-2x^9+...) (overpartition-type generating function)
Euler's identity: partitions into odd parts equal partitions into distinct parts
Bessel-function series (Hardy–Ramanujan–Rademacher type) for the number of partitions into distinct parts
Bessel-function series for the number of partitions into distinct odd parts
Asymptotic formula for the coefficients of 1/∏(1-ax^n), 0<a<1, with k = Li_2(a)
Transformation formula for the infinite product ∏(1-e^{-2πn x n^s}) in terms of zeta values and a double product over λ odd and ν
